meta.title: A PR amendment closes the previous version immediately
gaps: The plan does not explicitly verify that both the previous technical round and the latest pricing round have ended; the available library case verifies refusal of the bid on the superseded event version.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer updates the event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Renamed_…”.
The buyer issues a new version of the event with the item uuid set to “…”, with the item type set to “EventGroup”.
The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
